data.narrative:
Resolute Grid is a seed-stage company operating in the Climate & Energy sector. The comparable universe consists of nine peers in the sector: one public company (Linanza, ticker LNZA) and eight private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The Climate & Energy peer set, while nine companies deep, lacks sufficient clustering at seed stage or adjacent stages to support a reliable median multiple. Filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints—below the threshold required for meaningful triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would obscure stage-specific and capital-intensity dynamics material to seed-stage frontier energy companies.

Without sufficient narrow comparables or disclosed financial metrics for the peer set, this analysis cannot support a quantitative valuation range. The primary valuation uncertainty is the absence of both historical funding data for seed-stage peers and Resolute Grid's own fundraising history and operational metrics. Any valuation would require either: (1) expansion of the comparable set to include earlier-stage or adjacent climate-tech investments, or (2) introduction of bottom-up metrics such as capital efficiency, technical milestone achievement, or market addressability. Data collection on peer seed-round valuations and Resolute's own burn rate and runway would enable subsequent triangulation.
